notes.title: v1.1.2 - Out Now
notes.content:
[h2]More QoL![/h2]
- You can now drag-place platforms! This improves the experience a LOT
- Additionally, for other objects you can multi-place them by holding Alt
- Moving the camera with the mouse is now smoother
- Moving it is also proportional to your view, meaning that it doesn't offset
- Zooming in and out has also been improved in the editor
- You can now multi-select objects in bulk using Ctrl+Alt
- Speedrun timer bugs have been fixed
- Level loading bugs have been fixed
- Nerfed level 48
& more!

Pretty much, the editor is much better to use

notes.title: Level Competition — Get your level FEATURED!
notes.content:
[h2]I'm hosting an Airborne Level Competition! Join the Discord to participate:[/h2]
https://discord.gg/JjFzq5Pvh9

[h2]Rules:[/h2]
Submit your level/pack before March 31st
Don't copy other levels, make original creations
Your level must contain at least one 1.1 feature
You can submit up to three levels, but only one can win
Collab levels are allowed
[h2]Extras:[/h2]
Making your level unique would help it a lot. Use mechanics like underflinging, ceiling jumping etc.
Using 1.1 features as core gameplay would also help
Be creative, use objects for their non-intended purpose (e.g 0 mass physics blocks)
Level packs would be better, since they can hold more content
Decoration matters as much as gameplay, so do well for both
[h2]PRIZES:[/h2]
Top three levels will get the new SUPREME rating coming in v1.1.1
Additionally, winners will get the @Certified Airborner  role
Honorable mentions — levels that don't make the cut to win but are still great will get featured

[h2]SUBMITTING YOUR LEVELS[/h2]
Upload your levels to the Steam Workshop
If you have a limited steam account, meaning that you haven't spent above $5 on Steam then you can instead grab the level file from your files
Go to ⁠competition and share your level link/level file (to find it, go on the Online Levels page, go to your level, press the comments button and copy the link from your browser)

To find people to collab with, go to ⁠#collabs in the Discord.

notes.title: v1.1.0 is live!
notes.content:
[h1]v1.1.0 IS NOW LIVE[/h1]
After tons of work, v1.1.0 is officially out now on Steam! This major update includes a lot of features, so here’s a changelog.

[h2]What’s New:[/h2]
[h3]New object: Black Hole[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Functions as a teleporter
[*]  Includes additional force options
[*]  Can also teleport bullets
[/list]
[h3]Moving System Revamp: Now infinite![/h3]
[list]
[*] Setup infinite moving cycles in the editor
[*] Use time instead of speed
[*] Easing functions
[*] Visualiser for all moving points
[*] Now with fully consistent timings
[/list]
[h3]Level packs are here![/h3]
[list]
[*] Pack multiple rooms into one level and publish it to the workshop!
[/list]
[h3]New object: Checkpoint[/h3]
[list]
[*] Can also work as a startpos for level testing
[/list]
[h3]New component: Object Coloring[/h3]
[list]
[*] Color platforms and text using the new color picker!
[*] Make objects glow!
[*] Transparent option for objects
[/list]
[h3]New component: Physics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add physics to any object!
[*] Lock any axises and change the mass
[*] Can interact with launch pads and black holes
[/list]
[h3]Text: Now with more options[/h3]
[list]
[*] Along with coloring, text can now have bold and italics!
[*] Level (& pack) updating is now here! 
[*] Update your already-uploaded workshop submissions
[/list]
[h3]Two new achievements![/h3]
[list]
[*] Infinite Rooms — Upload your first level pack
[*] Dual Purpose — Find the secret easter egg
[/list]

[h2]Additionally:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Level loading has been fully optimized and over 500% faster
[*] Editable levels have been reworked!
    - Workshop levels go directly into play mode and can be copied & edited in the pause menu
[*] Preview player’s trail in the editor
[*] The game now has easier modding support
[*] Turrets now shoot fully consistently
[*] Level search filters are now saved between sessions
[*] Instead of closing, the editor now gives a log when an error occurs
[*] Reworked level search UI
[*] Fixed & improved the “My Levels” UI
[*] Nerfed level 48
[*] Added an easter egg..?
[/list]
& a lot more!

Big announcement in a few days!
[i](additionally, huge thanks to Grassified, Reimeiko & Dxtr for playtesting!)[/i]

[h2]A few words from me, bl4ck[/h2]
Thanks for playing Airborne! This update took a lot of time, but it's finally out. Airborne's success has been amazing, thanks for 100 reviews and 40,000 downloads! Me and XDev will continue bringing you some updates here and there, so stay tuned :)

notes.content:

notes.title: v1.0.3 - Physics Update & more!
notes.content:

- The player's jump doesn't get interrupted by rotating!
- Added coyote time for the player.
- Turrets now have an indicator when they are about to shoot.
- In the editor, when hovering over level borders they get transparent so you can see if any objects are behind them.
- Vertical Sync can now be changed in the settings menu
- Buffed level 47.
- Nerfed / reworked numerous levels, such as 50, 48, 18 & more.

- Online level loading shouldn't fail anymore.
- Object count limit in editor pause menu is now accurate.
- Turrets being inconsistent should now be fixed.
- Workshop agreement link now in the "Workshop Agreement Needed" UI
- Music & SFX slider now mutes the music when set to 0.
- Small speedrun mode fixes

& more!

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Featured Levels!
notes.content:
v1.0.2 OUT NOW
This update contains Rated / Featured Levels! These are hand picked by us and also shown on ⁠level-spotlight !

Patch Notes:
- Levels can now be rated / featured by the developers! This way, users can be assured that they're playing a good level.
- Level limits MASSIVELY increased, having an unlimited cap of objects for local levels and a 20k object cap for online levels.
- Most levels have been further optimized.
Speedrun mode is now in the settings! As well as options for what level you want to start from and what level to end the timer in. Restart the timer with K
- Small credits update
- When clicking play, levels will now have a loading animation
- The screen now shakes when you die
- Camera movement with WASD / Arrow Keys has been added
- Camera zooming can also be done with the - and = buttons now
- Ghost objects shouldn't appear when testing a level and doing Ctrl + Scroll
- Achievement "The Fun Doesn't End" works now
- Pause music & workshop level music will not overlap when pausing anymore
& more!

The first three featured levels (which have already been shown in ⁠level-spotlight) are:
Flappy Bird by mazroid, Buttons are fun by JoshLuul, Funky Factory by gemaidcol

Make sure to join the Discord if you have cool levels to submit or feedback! Your level could get featured if you submit it there :)
https://discord.gg/aS4Hn8DY

notes.title: v1.0.1 - Bug Fixes

& more!
